Verified live: Session-0 service bridges Lock/MonitorOff/SignOut into the active console session via CreateProcessAsUser of 'RemEx.Host.exe --session-task <verb>'. Root blocker was a P/Invoke marshaling bug (STARTUPINFO defaulted to ANSI while CreateProcessAsUserW is Unicode -> garbage lpDesktop -> STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED before Main). Fixed: STARTUPINFO CharSet.Unicode + StringBuilder lpCommandLine + CreateEnvironmentBlock/CREATE_UNICODE_ENVIRONMENT. MONITOROFF over IPC turned the physical monitor off (user-confirmed). Credit: Gemini 3.1 Pro second-opinion identified the marshaling mismatch.
